about_the_game:
■ Game System

Control the boat and defeat enemies with your shots.

Your HP decreases when you are hit by enemies or bullets.

If your HP reaches zero, it's game over.

□ Green Items

Collecting them fills the green bar on the screen. When it’s full, you receive a skill.

■ Blue Items

Collecting them draws all "□ Green" items on the screen toward you.

By combining skills,

you can obtain special weapons

or change existing skills.

Try different combinations and enjoy experimenting!

■ Controls

Keyboard Controls

Arrow Keys or Numpad: Move your character and navigate the cursor

S Key: Hold to charge, confirm

W Key: Use bomb

D Key: Weapon attack, cancel, skip dialogue

Space Key: Slow movement

Q Key: Pause/unpause

F1 Key: Options (key config, language settings)

Gamepad Controls

Stick/D-pad: Move your character and navigate the cursor

A Button: Hold to charge, confirm

B Button: Weapon attack, cancel, skip dialogue

R1 Button: Use bomb

L1 Button: Slow movement

Start Button: Pause/unpause

Select Button: Options (key config, language settings)

■ Story

After going out,

Atry finally returns home after a long time.

Just as she's about to head out again,

her mother calls out and stops her.

short_description: A roguelike action shooter where you dodge bullets, attack enemies, and power up with skills and items. While the map stays the same, different skill combos and item drops change your strategy each time. Keep challenging and master your own style!
